Klasse RecipeService

java.lang.Object
org.schmuh.quisine.services.RecipeService
@Service public class RecipeService extends Object
Service class for managing Recipe entities and their related operations.

This service class provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving recipes. It interacts with the repository layer for persistence and performs necessary mappings between entity objects and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs).

      public RecipeDto getRecipeById(Long id)
      Retrieves a RecipeDto by its unique ID.

      This method fetches the Recipe entity with the specified ID from the database, converts it to a RecipeDto, and returns the DTO.

      Parameter:
      id - The unique ID of the recipe.
      Gibt zurück:
      A RecipeDto representing the recipe with the given ID, or null if not found.

    • createRecipe

      public RecipeDto createRecipe(RecipeDto recipeDto)
      Creates a Recipe entity based on the provided RecipeDto.

      This method creates a new Recipe from the provided DTO, maps tags and ingredients to their respective entities, and persists the new recipe in the database.

      Parameter:
      recipeDto - The RecipeDto containing the recipe data to be created.
      Gibt zurück:
      The created RecipeDto with the assigned ID, or null if the recipe already exists.

      public Recipe saveRecipeMiddleware(Recipe recipe, RecipeDto recipeDto, boolean update)
      A helper method to map the fields of a RecipeDto to a Recipe entity.

      recipeDto - The RecipeDto containing the recipe data.
      Gibt zurück:

    • updateRecipeById

      public RecipeDto updateRecipeById(RecipeDto recipeDto)
      Updates a Recipe entity based on the provided RecipeDto.

      This method updates the fields of an existing recipe by using the data from the provided DTO. The updated recipe is then saved back into the database.

      Parameter:
      recipeDto - The RecipeDto containing the updated recipe data.
      Gibt zurück:
      The updated RecipeDto, or null if the recipe with the specified ID does not exist.

      Converts a Recipe entity to a RecipeDto.

      This method maps the fields of a Recipe entity to a RecipeDto, including tags and ingredients, which are also mapped to their respective DTOs.

      Parameter:
      recipe - The Recipe entity to be converted.
      Gibt zurück:
      A RecipeDto containing the data of the given recipe.
